exposure: hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (pregnancy-induced hypertension, pre-eclampsia, chronic hypertension with pre-eclampsia, eclampsia)
cohort: Pregnant women with hypertensive disorders having greater than 26 weeks of gestation.
finding: Maternal uric acid levels differ significantly across various hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and are correlated with mode of delivery and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery (vaginal, primary cesarean section, and repeat cesarean section) differed significantly among participants (p<0.001) and was found to be affected by maternal uric acid levels.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy (from 26 weeks gestation) and at delivery, between February and August 2021.
